title: Confirm product, operating entity and permitted source paths
owner: Product owner + editorial lead + qualified counsel
work: Resolve launch markets, source contracts, publisher-transcript permissions, reuse boundaries, privacy basis, editorial staffing and sustainable spend. Assess the current YouTube API policy before enabling any API-derived aggregation; do not infer permission from an accessible endpoint.
deliverables: Signed decision register; source-rights matrix; market/privacy review; budget cap; initial risk taxonomy.
exit_gate: At least one viable permitted discovery-to-evidence path is approved. Without that path, use fictional or explicitly authorized fixtures only; no public launch.

title: Define fixtures and approve the editorial design foundation
work: Build the Figma pages, variables, grids, type scale and core component states from the Design Brief. Create clearly fictional sample articles with full bottom bibliographies, long titles, conflicting evidence, removed sources and high-risk review examples.
deliverables: Approved reader/newsroom direction; shared token names; fixture corpus; screen coverage inventory.
exit_gate: SC01-SC06 and SC16-SC21 cover the primary reading, evidence, review and correction paths at required responsive widths. Accessibility annotations are present.

title: Create repository, contracts and isolated environments
work: Scaffold Nuxt/Vue, Express and worker applications with shared TypeScript contracts, linting, tests, CI, migration tooling and secrets references. Provision separate development, staging and production boundaries. Lock dependencies and review licenses.
deliverables: Reproducible local stack; baseline CI; secret scanning; preview deployment; architecture decision records.
exit_gate: A clean checkout builds and runs fixtures without production credentials. CI cannot deploy production from an untrusted branch or preview.

title: Implement identity, authorization and database foundations
work: Execute the reference schema in disposable PostgreSQL; refine it into ordered migrations. Add session and email/OIDC flows, staff MFA, role checks, safe account linking and transaction-local identity where RLS is used. Add ownership tests for every member route.
deliverables: Migration test report; identity flows; role matrix implementation; non-owner database test role.
exit_gate: Fresh install and upgrade tests pass. Cross-account reads, forged role changes, replayed email links and unverified account linking are rejected.

title: Build source governance and rights-aware intake
work: Implement source organizations, endpoint approval, versioned rights grants, credibility reviews, expiry and retention policies. Represent each intended use separately. Add newsroom source screens and explain why an ineligible source is blocked.
deliverables: SC07-SC08 public directory; SC17-SC18 governance screens; approval and expiry service.
exit_gate: A source may be credible yet prohibited for synthesis. Expired, mismatched or withdrawn permission fails every content-transfer gate.

title: Implement bounded retrieval and immutable item versions
work: Add permitted RSS/API/HTML or supplied-document adapters, canonicalization, restricted outbound networking, safe parsing, robots/provider checks, content hashing, retrieval observations and provenance. Quarantine unsupported formats and weak extraction.
deliverables: Fixture-backed adapter interface; SSRF controls; source observations; version deduplication; retry/dead-letter behavior.
exit_gate: Redirects to private addresses, DNS rebinding fixtures, oversized files, parser bombs and prompt-bearing source text cannot escape the ingestion boundary. A-B-A content observations remain accurate.

title: Implement the permissioned video evidence path
work: Support independently licensed publisher-supplied transcripts with source version, segment timing and declared provenance. Add safe exact-video links and optional policy-compliant player rendering. Keep API display metadata separate from transcript evidence and retention rules.
deliverables: Transcript import validation; timestamp citations; related-video fallback; deletion/availability fixtures.
exit_gate: A linked video without permitted transcript evidence never supports a claim or contributes to the evidence-source threshold. No arbitrary caption scraper is introduced.

title: Implement story clustering and reporting-origin review
work: Create clustering candidates, duplicate and syndication detection, structured event identity, merge/split review and reporting-origin associations. Store uncertain origins explicitly. Freeze revisions so later clustering changes cannot silently rewrite history.
deliverables: SC19 cluster review; independent-origin fixture labels; merge/split validation; evidence manifest skeleton.
exit_gate: Reprints count once for origin independence. Recurring events and same-name entities do not automatically merge. Manual changes invalidate affected evidence digests.

title: Build claims, locators and reproducible evidence packs
work: Extract atomic candidate claims and structured numeric/date context. Resolve evidence spans and support/contradiction/context relations. Add human review and immutable approved pack hashing, including rights versions and origin judgments.
deliverables: Claim/evidence service; side-by-side source inspection; evidence pack JSON schema; reverse impact traversal.
exit_gate: A reported allegation is not promoted to an established fact. Every eligible locator resolves to its exact permitted source version; contradictory evidence remains visible to reviewers.

title: Integrate structured generation and publication validators
work: Implement model-provider abstraction, policy-bound inputs, schema-constrained output, standard/brief variants, deterministic checks and advisory model checks. Record model/prompt versions, token/cost metadata and retry limits. Evaluate before choosing a provider/model.
deliverables: Generation contract; held-out evaluation suite; numeric/quote/attribution validators; cost accounting; model rollback procedure.
exit_gate: Unsupported IDs/URLs, omitted material citations, unreviewed contradiction resolution, rights failures and stale approvals are hard publication failures. No tool-enabled model can fetch or publish.

title: Build server-rendered discovery and search
work: Implement home, topic hubs, version-safe public projections, related-story trails, URL-restorable filters, load-more pagination and PostgreSQL search. Work from fixtures while content services are being completed.
deliverables: SC01-SC03; feed/search contracts; empty/error/stale states; keyboard paths; responsive layouts.
exit_gate: Anonymous requests never expose drafts or raw source text. Search excludes withdrawn material, including old snippets. Back navigation restores reader context.

title: Build article, citations and evidence reading surfaces
work: Implement the structured article renderer, brief/standard switching, inline source anchors, version-stable numbering, bottom bibliography, source inspection, related video distinction, print and link sharing. Preserve complete article/source HTML without JavaScript.
deliverables: SC04-SC05; safe source-link resolver; responsive evidence drawer/page; print stylesheet; accessible anchor navigation.
exit_gate: Every displayed citation resolves correctly. Both variants show version-wide source entries with clear per-view usage labels. The bottom bibliography is present without login or JavaScript.

title: Build member preferences and public accountability pages
work: Implement explicit topic follows, saved articles, accessible settings, methodology pages and publication-safe metadata. Add canonical URLs, sitemap updates, version-aware Article structured data, branded social previews and noindex controls for staff/private pages. Store only necessary preferences. Explain how articles are synthesized, reviewed and corrected without implying a numerical truth rating.
deliverables: SC10-SC12 and SC15; account-bound persistence; current-safe-version bookmarks; public metadata/sitemap tests.
exit_gate: Readers can browse sources without onboarding. Account preferences do not leak to other members; removed articles display a clear saved-item status.

title: Build newsroom review and atomic publication
work: Implement queues, assignment, workbench, factual-block inspection, approve/request-changes/reject, high-risk dual approval and idempotent publication. Bind approvals to the exact content/evidence digest and optimistic concurrency token.
deliverables: SC16/SC20; transactional publish service; immutable public version pointer; publication/outbox events; review audit.
exit_gate: Stale digest, missing approval, fewer than three eligible evidence items, fewer than two established origins or critical validation failure blocks publication. Concurrent requests cannot publish inconsistent content.

title: Build reporting, corrections and rights withdrawal
work: Implement anonymous issue reporting with version/claim context, triage, revision history, corrective re-review and immediate emergency suppression. Traverse source dependencies through bodies, variants, caches, prompts and other derivatives when rights are withdrawn.
deliverables: SC06/SC14/SC21; correction state machine; withdrawal runbook; source impact report; restoration workflow.
exit_gate: An emergency withdrawal suppresses all public variants and stale edge representations. Restoring an unsafe previous version is impossible without a fresh permitted review.

title: Implement jobs, telemetry, budgets and incident controls
work: Add queue visibility, request/job correlation, outbox reconciliation, retry/replay safeguards, metrics with privacy-safe dimensions, model-spend thresholds and feature flags. Prove that the public read path survives AI/provider unavailability.
deliverables: SC22-SC23; cost and failure dashboards; alert routing; pause/replay runbooks; dependency kill switches.
exit_gate: Repeated job delivery produces one intended effect. Exhausted budget stops new generation, never causes fallback to unreviewed content. Operators can reconcile lost Redis state from durable records.

title: Implement export, deletion and retention execution
work: Implement verified privacy requests, private expiring exports, session revocation, minimum-retention rules, derivative deletion and restore-time deletion-ledger replay. Separate staff audit obligations from ordinary reader deletion.
deliverables: SC25; retention scheduler; per-target completion evidence; backup/restore privacy procedure.
exit_gate: A 202 receipt is not shown as completed erasure. Cross-account exports are blocked; expired links fail; restoring a backup does not resurrect deleted reader data or withdrawn source content.

title: Complete accessibility, performance and security hardening
work: Run keyboard/screen-reader/reduced-motion checks, responsive and zoom tests, dependency/security review, CSP/CSRF/XSS/SSRF abuse cases and representative load tests. Optimize only measured bottlenecks; optional media cannot block reading.
deliverables: Accessibility report; load/security results; remediated critical/high defects; verified budgets; responsive comparison report.
exit_gate: Launch-target checks pass under the actual deployment roles and network controls. No unresolved critical security issue or inaccessible core reader/publication path remains.

title: Run editorial acceptance and recovery rehearsals
work: Rehearse complete stories from permitted intake through approval, correction and source removal. Include low-risk, high-risk, conflicting, video-supported and unpublishable packs. Restore from backup; test key rotation and identity-provider outage.
deliverables: Signed acceptance evidence; restore timing record; editorial staffing/capacity plan; approved go/no-go checklist.
exit_gate: All mandatory feature acceptance IDs pass, both article variants are reviewed, takedown and restoration drills pass, and owners explicitly accept residual noncritical risks.

title: Release a controlled edition and stabilize
owner: Release owner + editorial lead + platform engineer
work: Release approved topics/sources gradually, starting with a limited manually reviewed edition. Watch source freshness, failed jobs, citation defects, accessibility and cost. Maintain an incident rota and pause new publication on severe defects.
deliverables: Release record; flags and rollback evidence; operational handover; prioritized post-launch defect list.
exit_gate: Expansion is based on observed quality, staffing and capacity, not a calendar promise. Existing verified articles remain readable during an ingestion/generation pause.

title: Add explicitly consented alerts and source suggestions
work: Implement opt-in digests and story alerts, explicit saved-story subscriptions, timezone-aware preferences, unsubscribe/suppression, delivery deduplication and staff-triaged source suggestions. Specify provider/domain authentication and moderation before enabling delivery.
deliverables: SC13/SC27; additive V1 migrations including story-alert subscription relation; consent/delivery tests; suppression-aware email templates.
exit_gate: No message is sent without the applicable consent; unsubscribing wins races with queued delivery. Suggestions cannot trigger arbitrary URL fetch or create approved sources.

title: Add one explicitly selected additional language
work: Select a language based on readership and qualified review capacity. Add language-specific evidence provenance, source-text translation rules, locale routing/search, fallback notices and approval granularity. Each translated variant is independently reviewed against the same version evidence; never claim machine translation is a new reporting origin.
deliverables: Localized design fixtures, language-linked approval/schema addendum, locale metadata and correction propagation, human-reviewed evaluation set.
exit_gate: Every material localized claim has permitted provenance and qualified language review. Corrections or source withdrawal invalidate every affected translation. Unreviewed fallback text is never served as published.

title: Evaluate expansion through separate approved increments
work: Assess paid research features, collaborative collections, audio briefings, article-grounded questions and carefully gated automatic publishing against observed demand and rights. Do not reuse launch estimates as an implementation commitment for these separate products.
deliverables: An approved addendum per selected feature: user outcomes, schema/API changes, license implications, migration plan, threat model, design states and testable acceptance.
exit_gate: No V2 feature is enabled merely because a future navigation mockup exists. Citation access, corrections and public trust must not be degraded by monetization.
